evidence.origin: Conceptual shared campus authored 25 October 2026 around retained four-unit and switchyard anchors. Building dimensions, bay arrangement, circuit support sharing, conductor sag and access geometry are illustrative; no surveyed or electrical-clearance qualification. Separate campus-owned generator step-up installations derive their generator phase terminals from the exact related unit physical model.
